sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The Speaker of the House has ordered an impeachment inquiry into President Biden, putting into
sentences.zh: 众议院议长已下令对拜登总统展开弹劾调查，从而

sentences.en: a motion the third formal attempt by Congress to remove a president in the past four years.
sentences.zh: 启动了国会在过去四年中第三次正式罢免总统的尝试。

sentences.en: Today, I spoke with my colleague, Luke Broadwater, about the unique realities behind this one.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与我的同事卢克·布罗德沃特谈到了这次弹劾背后的独特现实。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月15日，星期五。

sentences.en: Luke, I want you to walk us through this news conference a few days ago in which Speaker
sentences.zh: 卢克，我想请你带我们回顾一下几天前的那场新闻发布会，当时议长

sentences.en: Kevin McCarthy explains this pretty momentous decision to open an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡锡宣布了这一开启弹劾调查的重大决定。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, the House had just come back from a long August recess and was about to gavel in to start its September session.
sentences.zh: 众议院刚结束漫长的八月休会，正准备敲槌开始九月的会议。

sentences.en: And Kevin McCarthy calls a snap news conference outside of the Speaker's office, what we call the small rotunda at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡锡在议长办公室外，也就是我们所说的国会大厦小圆形大厅，召开了一场临时新闻发布会。

sentences.en: And he walks out.
sentences.zh: 他走了出来。

sentences.en: Welcome back, everyone.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家回来。

sentences.en: He sets somewhat of a somber tone.
sentences.zh: 他定下了一种略显沉重的基调。

sentences.en: You know, the months that we were gone, in the weeks, House Republicans have uncovered serious and credible allegations into President Biden's conduct.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我们离开的这几个月里，在过去几周，众议院共和党人发现了关于拜登总统行为的严重且可信的指控。

sentences.en: And he begins to lay out why he believes there needs to be an impeachment inquiry into President
sentences.zh: 他开始阐述为什么他认为有必要对拜登总统进行弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Biden.
sentences.zh: 拜登。

sentences.en: Now, here's what we know so far.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是我们目前所知道的情况。

sentences.en: Through our investigations, we have found that President Biden did lie to the American people about his own knowledge of his family's foreign business dealings.
sentences.zh: 通过调查，我们发现拜登总统确实就他对自己家人海外商业交易的了解程度向美国人民撒了谎。

sentences.en: The first thing he says is that President Biden lied about his son, Hunter Biden's business dealings.
sentences.zh: 他说的第一件事是拜登总统在关于他儿子亨特·拜登的商业交易上撒了谎。

sentences.en: There is evidence that President Biden made at least one very prominent false statement and that other times he oversimplified or maybe made misstatements when describing the
sentences.zh: 有证据表明，拜登总统至少发表了一次非常显眼的虚假陈述，而在其他时候，他在描述这些

sentences.en: business interactions.
sentences.zh: 商业互动时，可能过度简化或发表了不实言论。

sentences.en: Eyewitnesses have testified that the president joined on multiple phone calls and had multiple interactions.
sentences.zh: 目击者作证称，总统多次参与了电话会议并进行了多次互动。

sentences.en: But then he makes a series of allegations about conduct that Hunter Biden engaged in and attempts to link it to President Biden.
sentences.zh: 但随后他提出了一系列关于亨特·拜登所从事行为的指控，并试图将其与拜登总统联系起来。

sentences.en: And he does it in a way that is not really backed up to date by any hard or concrete evidence.
sentences.zh: 而且他这样做的方式，迄今为止并没有任何确凿或具体的证据支持。

sentences.en: And that really is the link that has been missing so far for the House Republicans, who through
sentences.zh: 这确实是众议院共和党人目前缺失的环节，他们通过

sentences.en: their various committees for months now have, of course, been investigating President Biden and his family.
sentences.zh: 各自的委员会已经调查拜登总统及其家人好几个月了。

sentences.en: I'll give you one real quick example.
sentences.zh: 我给你举一个非常简单的例子。

sentences.en: Dinners resulted in cars and millions of dollars into his son's and his son's business partners.
sentences.zh: 晚宴换来了汽车，以及数百万美元流入他儿子及其商业伙伴的口袋。

sentences.en: In McCarthy's speech, he suggests that Biden is responsible for getting his son millions of dollars and fancy cars and things like that.
sentences.zh: 在麦卡锡的演讲中，他暗示拜登应对其儿子获得数百万美元和豪车等财物负责。

sentences.en: And, you know, Hunter Biden did get expensive gifts and millions of dollars from overseas business interests.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，亨特·拜登确实从海外商业利益中获得了昂贵的礼物和数百万美元。

sentences.en: What McCarthy is alleging and what Republicans have yet to prove is that it was Joe Biden's intervention that caused those things to happen.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡所指控的，以及共和党人尚未证明的是，正是乔·拜登的干预导致了这些事情的发生。

sentences.en: All they've uncovered so far is that on occasion, Joe Biden exchanged niceties with business associates of his son, things like chatting about the weather or a handshake.
sentences.zh: 他们迄今为止发现的只是，乔·拜登偶尔会与他儿子的商业伙伴寒暄，比如聊聊天气或握握手。

sentences.en: They have not produced any concrete evidence that he was directly involved in any of these business activities himself.
sentences.zh: 他们没有拿出任何确凿证据证明他本人直接参与了这些商业活动。

sentences.en: But that's the type of thing the Republicans are digging into to try to prove.
sentences.zh: 但这正是共和党人试图挖掘并证明的事情。

sentences.en: That's why today I am directing our House committee to open a formal impeachment inquiry into President
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么今天我指示我们的众议院委员会对乔·拜登总统展开正式弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登。

sentences.en: He makes clear that he believes these are allegations, that they are not proven, that there is no immediate
sentences.zh: 他明确表示，他认为这些只是指控，尚未得到证实，目前并没有

sentences.en: pending impeachment, but that he believes an impeachment investigation is necessary to get to the bottom of them.
sentences.zh: 迫在眉睫的弹劾，但他认为有必要进行弹劾调查以查明真相。

sentences.en: We are committed to getting the answers for the American public.
sentences.zh: 我们致力于为美国公众寻求答案。

sentences.en: Nothing more, nothing less.
sentences.zh: 不多不少，仅此而已。

sentences.en: We will go wherever the evidence takes us.
sentences.zh: 我们将追随证据指向的任何地方。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So in summary, McCarthy is laying out actual evidence of misstatements that President Biden has made while president, perhaps knowingly, perhaps unknowingly, about his son Hunter's
sentences.zh: 所以总结一下，麦卡锡列举了拜登总统在任期间所作出的实际不实陈述的证据，也许是有意的，也许是无意的，关于他儿子亨特的

sentences.en: business dealings.
sentences.zh: 商业交易。

sentences.en: And McCarthy is pairing that with allegations for which there's not really much evidence
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡将此与一些指控结合起来，而这些指控并没有太多证据支持，

sentences.en: that Biden was directly involved in those deals back when he was vice president or afterward.
sentences.zh: 即拜登在担任副总统期间或之后直接参与了这些交易。

sentences.en: So at the heart of this is essentially the claim that before Biden was president, he acted in a corrupt manner.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一切的核心本质上是声称拜登在担任总统之前，行为存在腐败。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Most of the allegations stem from a period of time when Joe Biden was vice president, although
sentences.zh: 大多数指控源于乔·拜登担任副总统的那段时间，尽管

sentences.en: they are now alleging also that once he becomes president, his administration is engaged in sort
sentences.zh: 他们现在也声称，在他成为总统后，他的政府在某种程度上对这些指控视而不见，

sentences.en: of turning a blind eye to these allegations and not investigating fully the case against Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 并没有对亨特·拜登的案件进行全面调查。

sentences.en: Basically, that there's a kind of cover up.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就是存在某种掩盖行为。

sentences.en: Yes, they do allege a cover up without a ton of evidence, but they allege a cover up.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们确实指控存在掩盖行为，虽然没有大量证据，但他们确实指控了掩盖。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, no new bombshell evidence implicating President Biden has just been revealed.
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，并没有揭露任何牵连拜登总统的重磅新证据。

sentences.en: No single smoking gun that explains McCarthy's decision.
sentences.zh: 没有单一的“确凿证据”能解释麦卡锡的决定。

sentences.en: I mean, everything he has laid out here that we're talking about is familiar, and yet it never before merited an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在这里列出的我们正在讨论的一切都是大家熟悉的，但以前从未值得进行弹劾调查。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in fact, the vast majority of the Republican case against Biden has existed for years.
sentences.zh: 事实上，共和党针对拜登的大部分指控已经存在多年了。

sentences.en: I mean, Senate Republicans did a lengthy report in 2020 that has the majority of these allegations in it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，参议院共和党人在2020年做了一份详尽的报告，其中包含了这些指控的大部分内容。

sentences.en: Now, they have added some new facts and some new evidence in the past year, but it's not something that fundamentally changes the nature of the case.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们在过去一年里增加了一些新的事实和证据，但这并没有从根本上改变案件的性质。

sentences.en: So if there's not super damning new evidence, Luke, help us understand the timing of this.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果并没有特别确凿的新证据，卢克，帮我们理解一下这个时机。

sentences.en: We have known, of course, that Republicans have wanted to impeach President Biden pretty much since the moment he took office.
sentences.zh: 我们当然知道，共和党人几乎从拜登就职的那一刻起就想弹劾他。

sentences.en: But why right now?
sentences.zh: 但为什么是现在？

sentences.en: Why this week?
sentences.zh: 为什么是这周？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: No, you're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 不，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: From day one of Biden's presidency, some members of Congress have started introducing articles of impeachment against him.
sentences.zh: 从拜登总统任期的第一天起，一些国会议员就开始提出针对他的弹劾条款。

sentences.en: They've wanted to impeach him over the situation at the border.
sentences.zh: 他们想因为边境局势弹劾他。

sentences.en: They've wanted to impeach him over the fentanyl crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们想因为芬太尼危机弹劾他。

sentences.en: They've wanted to impeach him over the withdrawal from Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 他们想因为从阿富汗撤军弹劾他。

sentences.en: So there are a number of reasons why they have gone after Biden from the start.
sentences.zh: 所以他们从一开始就针对拜登有很多原因。

sentences.en: And so for most of that time, Kevin McCarthy has tried to hold off the right wing of his party.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，凯文·麦卡锡一直试图抵挡党内右翼的压力。

sentences.en: He says there should be no impeachment for political reasons.
sentences.zh: 他说不应该出于政治原因进行弹劾。

sentences.en: He said Republicans should be above that.
sentences.zh: 他说共和党人应该超越这一点。

sentences.en: They should follow a process where evidence is gathered.
sentences.zh: 他们应该遵循收集证据的程序。

sentences.en: He's also repeatedly maintained that no impeachment inquiry should be opened without a vote of the full House,
sentences.zh: 他还一再坚持，未经众议院全体投票，不应开启弹劾调查，

sentences.en: that it should have the support of the majority of the body before any impeachment inquiry is ever undertaken.
sentences.zh: 在进行任何弹劾调查之前，应该得到众议院多数成员的支持。

sentences.en: But there's a couple of things you need to understand.
sentences.zh: 但你需要了解几件事。

sentences.en: One, Kevin McCarthy is clinging to the speakership by the thinnest of margins.
sentences.zh: 第一，凯文·麦卡锡正以极其微弱的优势勉强维持议长职位。

sentences.en: Remember, he only became speaker after making a ton of concessions to the hard right.
sentences.zh: 记住，他是在对极右翼做出大量让步后才成为议长的。

sentences.en: And one of those concessions was agreeing that any one member at any time, if they were dissatisfied with Kevin McCarthy, could call a vote to remove him.
sentences.zh: 其中一个让步是同意任何成员在任何时候，如果对凯文·麦卡锡不满，都可以要求进行罢免投票。

sentences.en: And on top of that, remember when we were barreling toward default on our debt and in order to avoid that, McCarthy cut a spending deal with the White House?
sentences.zh: 此外，还记得我们当时正处于债务违约的边缘，为了避免这种情况，麦卡锡与白宫达成了支出协议吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: Well, the hard right remains really mad at him for that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，极右翼仍然对此非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And we are entering a period now where McCarthy has to make good on that deal and fund the government by the deadline on September 30th.
sentences.zh: 我们现在进入了一个时期，麦卡锡必须履行该协议，并在9月30日的截止日期前为政府提供资金。

sentences.en: And the hard right is saying, no way, we're not voting for those bills.
sentences.zh: 而极右翼说，没门，我们不会投票支持这些法案。

sentences.en: And they're telling McCarthy the only way he gets their votes and avoids the government shutdown is to make some concessions.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉麦卡锡，他获得他们选票并避免政府停摆的唯一途径就是做出一些让步。

sentences.en: And one of those concessions is impeaching President Biden.
sentences.zh: 而其中一个让步就是弹劾拜登总统。

sentences.en: So these hard right House Republicans are explicitly saying to the speaker over whom they have a tremendous amount of leverage given their slim majority,
sentences.zh: 所以这些极右翼众议院共和党人明确地对议长说，考虑到他们微弱的多数席位，他们对议长拥有巨大的影响力，

sentences.en: we are angry about the spending deal you struck with Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们对你与乔·拜登达成的支出协议感到愤怒。

sentences.en: We don't like it.
sentences.zh: 我们不喜欢它。

sentences.en: But you should know that if you want us to support that kind of a budget, you need to go after Joe Biden with something like impeachment.
sentences.zh: 但你应该知道，如果你想让我们支持那种预算，你需要用弹劾之类的事情来对付乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Yes, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Some of them have made that very explicit and said an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden was necessary for their vote to keep the government open.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人已经说得很明确，称对乔·拜登的弹劾调查是他们投票支持政府继续运作的必要条件。

sentences.en: And so those are the real dynamics at play and the great pressures on Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是真正的博弈动态，也是凯文·麦卡锡所面临的巨大压力。

sentences.en: But I think the thing that really tips it over the edge is the actions of Congressman Matt Gaetz of Florida.
sentences.zh: 但我认为真正让局势失控的是佛罗里达州众议员马特·盖茨的行动。

sentences.en: Matt Gaetz lets it be known that as soon as the House is back in session,
sentences.zh: 马特·盖茨放出话来，一旦众议院复会，

sentences.en: he plans to give a blistering floor speech against Kevin McCarthy in which he is going to demand that Kevin McCarthy come into compliance with the far right or face removal from the speakership.
sentences.zh: 他计划发表一场针对凯文·麦卡锡的激烈演讲，要求凯文·麦卡锡顺从极右翼，否则就面临被罢免议长职位的风险。

sentences.en: And it's clear that one of the demands Gates is planning to make is that McCarthy get a lot tougher on President Biden and his son Hunter.
sentences.zh: 很明显，盖茨计划提出的要求之一是麦卡锡必须对拜登总统及其儿子亨特采取更强硬的态度。

sentences.en: And the clear implication here is that McCarthy better get going with impeachment or he's going to face some real consequences.
sentences.zh: 这里明确的暗示是，麦卡锡最好开始弹劾，否则他将面临真正的后果。

sentences.en: So there is now a very direct,
sentences.zh: 所以现在有一个非常直接、

sentences.en: imminent and specific public threat from Matt Gaetz against McCarthy's future as speaker unless he immediately complies with this request to open an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 迫在眉睫且具体的公开威胁，来自马特·盖茨，针对麦卡锡作为议长的未来，除非他立即顺从这一开启弹劾调查的要求。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so Kevin McCarthy is faced with this choice.
sentences.zh: 所以凯文·麦卡锡面临着这个选择。

sentences.en: Either he can keep with a position he's held for a long time that an impeachment inquiry should only be opened with a full vote of the House.
sentences.zh: 要么他可以坚持他长期以来的立场，即弹劾调查只能在众议院全体投票后开启。

sentences.en: At present, he lacks the votes to do that, I'll note.
sentences.zh: 我得指出，目前他缺乏足够的票数来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Or he can change his position,
sentences.zh: 要么他可以改变立场，

sentences.en: give in to Matt Gaetz's demand and unilaterally order the impeachment inquiry and looking at the best way he can try to stay speaker and cling to his speakership.
sentences.zh: 屈服于马特·盖茨的要求，单方面下令进行弹劾调查，并寻找他能保住议长职位并继续掌权的最好方法。

sentences.en: He makes what I think a lot of Republicans believe was the only choice he could make politically, and that is to go ahead, change his position, reverse his previous statements,
sentences.zh: 他做出了我认为许多共和党人认为他在政治上唯一能做的选择，那就是继续前进，改变立场，推翻他之前的声明，

sentences.en: and order an impeachment inquiry to, in some ways, keep his job.
sentences.zh: 并下令进行弹劾调查，在某种程度上保住他的工作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we know exactly what happens next.
sentences.zh: 我们很清楚接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: McCarthy comes out, delivers this speech, announcing that he's going to open this impeachment inquiry, does exactly what he knows Congressman Gaetz wants him to do.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡出来发表了演讲，宣布他将开启这项弹劾调查，完全按照他知道盖茨议员想要他做的那样去做。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So McCarthy gets ahead of Gaetz.
sentences.zh: 所以麦卡锡抢在了盖茨前面。

sentences.en: He positions himself as the aggressive actor against President Biden, which is always a good position to be in if you want to appeal to the far right of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 他将自己定位为针对拜登总统的激进派，如果你想吸引共和党内的极右翼，这总是一个很好的立场。

sentences.en: But Matt Gaetz doesn't back down.
sentences.zh: 但马特·盖茨并没有退缩。

sentences.en: I rise today to serve notice.
sentences.zh: 我今天站出来发出通知。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, you are out of compliance with the agreement that allowed you to assume this role.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，你没有遵守让你担任此职位的协议。

sentences.en: He gives the floor speech anyway.
sentences.zh: 他还是发表了那场演讲。

sentences.en: The path forward for the House of Representatives is to either bring you into immediate total compliance or remove you pursuant to a motion to vacate the chair.
sentences.zh: 众议院前进的道路要么是让你立即完全合规，要么根据罢免议长的动议将你罢免。

sentences.en: And he proceeds to lay out all the ways Kevin McCarthy is failing at speaker.
sentences.zh: 他接着列举了凯文·麦卡锡作为议长失败的所有方式。

sentences.en: But here we are eight months later, and we haven't even sent the first subpoena to Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 但八个月过去了，我们甚至还没有向亨特·拜登发出第一张传票。

sentences.en: That's how you know that the rushed and, you know, somewhat rattled performance you just saw from the speaker isn't real at this point.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你知道你刚才看到的议长那场仓促且有些慌乱的表现，在这一点上并不是真的。

sentences.en: So he makes clear he was not satisfied with McCarthy's speech.
sentences.zh: 所以他明确表示他对麦卡锡的演讲不满意。

sentences.en: I know that Washington isn't a town where people are known for keeping their word.
sentences.zh: 我知道华盛顿不是一个以守信闻名的城市。

sentences.en: Well, Speaker McCarthy, I'm here to hold you to yours.
sentences.zh: 好吧，麦卡锡议长，我在这里要你信守承诺。

sentences.en: So this must have been pretty disappointing for McCarthy because his call for the impeachment inquiry and Gaetz gives this searing speech anyway.
sentences.zh: 所以这对麦卡锡来说一定很令人失望，因为他呼吁进行弹劾调查，而盖茨还是发表了这番尖刻的演讲。

sentences.en: Well, if you look at it from McCarthy's point of view, he thinks he won the day.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你从麦卡锡的角度来看，他认为他赢得了这一天。

sentences.en: If you look at all the headlines and the news coverage, it's all about Kevin McCarthy getting tough with Biden, him moving forward with this impeachment.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看所有的头条新闻和媒体报道，全是关于凯文·麦卡锡对拜登强硬，他推进了这项弹劾。

sentences.en: And that is for someone who has to govern the Republican Party in the House and the far right.
sentences.zh: 对于一个必须管理众议院共和党和极右翼的人来说，

sentences.en: That's a good day for Kevin McCarthy when he looks tough on Biden.
sentences.zh: 当麦卡锡看起来对拜登强硬时，这对凯文·麦卡锡来说是美好的一天。

sentences.en: And there's almost no headlines about Matt Gaetz calling for his removal, which in an alternate scenario could have been the news of the day,
sentences.zh: 几乎没有任何关于马特·盖茨呼吁罢免他的头条新闻，而在另一种情况下，这本可能是当天的新闻，

sentences.en: which would have been the far right pressures McCarthy calls for him to step down.
sentences.zh: 那将是极右翼向麦卡锡施压要求他下台。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Luke, suffice it to say, this is not the normal course by which an impeachment inquiry,
sentences.zh: 卢克，恕我直言，这并不是弹劾调查的常规流程，

sentences.en: this really grave historic decision is opened as basically job security to save your job as House Speaker.
sentences.zh: 这项极其严肃的历史性决策，本质上竟然是为了保住你众议院议长的职位。

sentences.en: Well, it's not just about job security.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不仅仅是为了保住职位。

sentences.en: Remember, he's also doing this to try to avoid a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，他这么做也是为了试图避免政府停摆。

sentences.en: Kevin McCarthy is very interested in making sure it's seen that Republicans can operate a functioning government and not plunge the country into chaos.
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡锡非常希望确保外界认为共和党人能够维持政府正常运转，而不是让国家陷入混乱。

sentences.en: And so McCarthy may have won the day and he may have staved off the hard right detractors for some time.
sentences.zh: 所以，麦卡锡可能暂时赢得了局面，也可能暂时安抚了极右翼的反对者。

sentences.en: But now he's stuck with a unilateral impeachment inquiry, which is something that he never wanted to do in the first place.
sentences.zh: 但现在他被困在了一项单方面的弹劾调查中，而这本是他最初绝不想做的事情。

sentences.en: And now he has to live with that and all the complicated implications that go along with it.
sentences.zh: 现在他必须接受这一点，以及随之而来的所有复杂影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏版块《Connections》的作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》等每日游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: So, look, what will the opening of this impeachment inquiry that Speaker McCarthy is now stuck with do and mean exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么，麦卡锡议长现在陷入的这项弹劾调查，究竟会带来什么，又意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: People like Matt Gaetz have wanted this, but precisely why do they want it?
sentences.zh: 像马特·盖茨这样的人一直想要这个，但他们究竟为什么想要？

sentences.en: What powers, in their minds, does it give House Republicans looking into Biden that they didn't already have?
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，这赋予了众议院共和党人调查拜登的哪些他们原本不具备的权力？

sentences.en: Well, functionally, it doesn't actually change all that much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从功能上讲，它其实并没有改变太多。

sentences.en: You already have three congressional committees investigating President Biden's administration and President Biden's family.
sentences.zh: 你们已经有三个国会委员会在调查拜登总统的政府和拜登总统的家人了。

sentences.en: They already have subpoena power.
sentences.zh: 他们已经拥有传唤权。

sentences.en: But Congress derives its authority from the fact that it's part of the legislative process.
sentences.zh: 但国会的权力源于它是立法程序的一部分这一事实。

sentences.en: And so a traditional congressional investigation really only is valid in the eyes of the courts, in the eyes of the law,
sentences.zh: 因此，传统的国会调查在法院和法律眼中只有在一种情况下才真正有效，

sentences.en: if they're actually engaged in some attempt at legislating, rewriting a law, changing a statute, introducing new legislation.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们确实在尝试立法、重写法律、修改法规或引入新法案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But if a committee or committees embark on an impeachment inquiry, they no longer have to come up with legislative reasons for what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 但如果一个或多个委员会启动弹劾调查，他们就不再需要为自己的行为寻找立法理由了。

sentences.en: They don't have to try to pretend they're really rewriting the ethics code, right?
sentences.zh: 他们不必假装自己真的在重写道德准则，对吧？

sentences.en: They can simply say, we're demanding these documents because we are investigating whether or not the president committed high crimes or misdemeanors.
sentences.zh: 他们可以直接说，我们要求提供这些文件，因为我们正在调查总统是否犯下了重罪或轻罪。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And so it gives them, they believe, a better argument in court should some of their actions get challenged by the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为，如果他们的某些行动受到拜登政府的挑战，这能让他们在法庭上拥有更有力的论据。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Because up until now, they have, if we're being honest, needed to manufacture a legislative reason to look into Hunter Biden and Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 因为说实话，到目前为止，他们一直需要编造一个立法理由来调查亨特·拜登和乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Perhaps they would argue, we want to strengthen influence-peddling laws.
sentences.zh: 也许他们会辩称，我们想要加强反游说法律。

sentences.en: So that's why we're looking into Hunter Biden and Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们调查亨特·拜登和乔·拜登的原因。

sentences.en: But in reality, that's not quite what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这并不是他们真正在做的事情。

sentences.en: And now that they have an impeachment inquiry, they don't need such an excuse.
sentences.zh: 现在有了弹劾调查，他们就不需要这样的借口了。

sentences.en: And they will have greater legal footing for a really aggressive investigation into both.
sentences.zh: 而且他们将有更坚实的法律基础，对两人进行真正激进的调查。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And I'm curious, were these committees running into any legal limitation in their existing investigations of Hunter and Joe Biden?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，这些委员会在现有的对亨特和乔·拜登的调查中是否遇到了任何法律限制？

sentences.en: Or was this just House Republicans anticipating that they might run into these problems?
sentences.zh: 还是说这只是众议院共和党人预见到他们可能会遇到这些问题？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's very much the latter.
sentences.zh: 是的，很大程度上是后者。

sentences.en: Republicans have not faced a ton of fight from the Biden White House or from banks as they've been trying to get these records.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在试图获取这些记录时，并没有遭到拜登白宫或银行的强烈抵制。

sentences.en: James Comer, who's the chairman of the Oversight Committee, said in the past six months, every single subpoena he has sent out has been complied with 100 percent.
sentences.zh: 监督委员会主席詹姆斯·科默表示，在过去六个月里，他发出的每一份传票都得到了百分之百的配合。

sentences.en: So it's not because they've been encountering resistance to date.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是因为他们迄今为止遇到了阻力。

sentences.en: It's that they believe they will encounter resistance and want to have their strongest argument for demanding the records that they are about to demand.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们相信自己会遇到阻力，并希望在索要即将索要的记录时拥有最强有力的论据。

sentences.en: So from what you're saying, opening an impeachment inquiry doesn't fundamentally change these investigations.
sentences.zh: 所以照你所说，启动弹劾调查并不会从根本上改变这些调查。

sentences.en: It gives Republicans more legal confidence in the investigations.
sentences.zh: 它只是让共和党人在调查中更有法律底气。

sentences.en: But of course, impeachment has another very clear advantage for House Republicans, which is political.
sentences.zh: 但当然，弹劾对众议院共和党人还有另一个非常明显的优势，那就是政治上的优势。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是。

sentences.en: It serves a number of purposes for Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 这对凯文·麦卡锡来说有多种用途。

sentences.en: One, it helps him politically on the Hill.
sentences.zh: 第一，这在国会山对他有政治帮助。

sentences.en: It helps stave off those hard-right Republicans who have been calling for his head.
sentences.zh: 这有助于安抚那些一直要求他下台的极右翼共和党人。

sentences.en: Two, it helps settle a political score.
sentences.zh: 第二，这有助于报一箭之仇。

sentences.en: There are a lot of Republicans on the Hill who still are bitter about the impeachments of Donald Trump, particularly the first impeachment, which they argue had thin evidence.
sentences.zh: 国会山有很多共和党人对唐纳德·特朗普的弹劾案仍耿耿于怀，尤其是第一次弹劾，他们认为那次弹劾证据不足。

sentences.en: That was the impeachment, of course, where Donald Trump was on a phone call with the leader of Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 当然，那次弹劾是因为唐纳德·特朗普与乌克兰领导人通了电话，

sentences.en: and the allegation was that he was shaking him down to try to dig up dirt on Joe Biden and withholding aid because of it.
sentences.zh: 指控称他试图通过扣留援助来勒索对方，以挖掘乔·拜登的黑料。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we should say, dig up dirt not just on Joe Biden, but on Joe Biden's son Hunter and many of the things that Republicans are now trying to look into.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，挖掘的不仅是乔·拜登的黑料，还有乔·拜登的儿子亨特的，以及共和党人现在试图调查的许多事情。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Time is a flat circle.
sentences.zh: 时间是一个平坦的圆圈。

sentences.en: It is all coming back around again.
sentences.zh: 一切又回到了原点。

sentences.en: But they're still bitter over that.
sentences.zh: 但他们对此仍怀恨在心。

sentences.en: And they've been looking to exact revenge on Joe Biden and the Democrats because of the impeachments of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为唐纳德·特朗普的弹劾案，他们一直寻求向乔·拜登和民主党人复仇。

sentences.en: Three, Kevin McCarthy believes it's effective politically because, you know, Donald Trump is facing four criminal indictments,
sentences.zh: 第三，凯文·麦卡锡认为这在政治上很有效，因为你知道，唐纳德·特朗普正面临四项刑事起诉，

sentences.en: 91 felony counts on a range of very serious allegations against his conduct while he was president and even before he was president.
sentences.zh: 涉及91项重罪指控，涵盖了他担任总统期间甚至担任总统之前的一系列非常严重的指控。

sentences.en: And they're hoping that an impeachment inquiry will muddy the waters in the minds of voters and create the impression that, well,
sentences.zh: 他们希望弹劾调查能搅浑选民的视线，制造一种印象，即，嗯，

sentences.en: I don't know who's more corrupt between Joe Biden and Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我不知道乔·拜登和唐纳德·特朗普之间谁更腐败。

sentences.en: And so it's hard for me to say as a voter.
sentences.zh: 作为选民，我很难说清楚。

sentences.en: And then the fourth thing, and I think, you know, this is what they're holding out hope for, is that as they dig deeper into Joe Biden, as they dig deeper into Hunter Biden,
sentences.zh: 第四点，我认为，你知道，这是他们抱有希望的地方，那就是随着他们对乔·拜登和亨特·拜登挖掘得越深，

sentences.en: as they turn over more and more stones, that eventually they may in fact find that smoking gun, which to date they have not.
sentences.zh: 随着他们翻开的石头越来越多，最终他们可能真的会找到那把“冒烟的枪”，而到目前为止他们还没有找到。

sentences.en: And so they're holding out that if they just keep digging, eventually they might get that really damning piece of evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以他们坚持认为，如果继续挖掘，最终可能会得到那份真正确凿的证据。

sentences.en: Well, to that point, let's talk about where this all now leads or doesn't lead, this impeachment inquiry,
sentences.zh: 说到这一点，让我们谈谈这项弹劾调查现在走向何方，或者是否会走向何方，

sentences.en: given the nature of an impeachment inquiry and the realities of this very narrow House Republican majority.
sentences.zh: 考虑到弹劾调查的性质以及众议院共和党人微弱多数的现实。

sentences.en: Well, functionally for the Hill, an impeachment inquiry can become an all-encompassing exercise.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从功能上讲，对于国会山来说，弹劾调查可能会变成一项包罗万象的活动。

sentences.en: It can suck all the air out of the room of anything else this Congress might want to do.
sentences.zh: 它可能会吸走这个国会可能想要做的任何其他事情的所有空气。

sentences.en: And it will become the focus of a lot of media attention and a lot of the work that lawmakers are doing.
sentences.zh: 它将成为媒体关注的焦点，也是议员们工作的重心。

sentences.en: So it will have an intense effect on the operations of the Hill as long as the impeachment inquiry lasts.
sentences.zh: 因此，只要弹劾调查持续，它就会对国会山的运作产生强烈影响。

sentences.en: Politically, though, there are quite a few Republicans who are dreading bringing this to a vote.
sentences.zh: 不过在政治上，有不少共和党人对将此事付诸表决感到恐惧。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I mean, just as evidence of that, Kevin McCarthy does not have the votes right now, even among Republicans,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，作为证据，凯文·麦卡锡现在甚至没有足够的票数，即使是在共和党内部，

sentences.en: to even open an impeachment inquiry if he put this to a floor vote.
sentences.zh: 如果他把这件事提交到全院表决，甚至无法启动弹劾调查。

sentences.en: There are quite a few Republicans on the Hill who say we haven't seen any hard evidence.
sentences.zh: 国会山有不少共和党人表示，我们还没有看到任何确凿的证据。

sentences.en: Everything we've seen is innuendo and circumstantial evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的一切都是影射和间接证据。

sentences.en: And we're not willing to impeach without something concrete.
sentences.zh: 如果没有实质性的东西，我们不愿意弹劾。

sentences.en: And so in order to try to convince his full membership to go along with this, he's got to produce better and stronger evidence against the president.
sentences.zh: 所以为了说服他的全体成员支持这一点，他必须拿出针对总统更好、更强有力的证据。

sentences.en: Right now, they have 14 Republicans who represent districts that were won by President Biden.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们有14名共和党议员代表的选区是由拜登总统赢得的。

sentences.en: And forcing those Republicans to vote to impeach the president who won their districts and is popular with their voters, in some people's view,
sentences.zh: 在某些人看来，强迫这些共和党人投票弹劾在他们选区获胜且受选民欢迎的总统，

sentences.en: that's a recipe for losing the House.
sentences.zh: 那是失去众议院的秘诀。

sentences.en: It's a recipe for a very unpopular vote for these Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这对这些共和党人来说是一次非常不受欢迎的投票。

sentences.en: And, in fact, I was talking to Democrats on the Hill just yesterday who believe that this impeachment inquiry will help them with moderate voters.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我昨天还在和国会山的民主党人交谈，他们认为这项弹劾调查会帮助他们争取温和派选民。

sentences.en: They think that if moderate voters look at the House and they see Republicans clamoring for both a shutdown and a political impeachment of the president,
sentences.zh: 他们认为，如果温和派选民看着众议院，看到共和党人既吵着要政府停摆，又吵着要对总统进行政治弹劾，

sentences.en: that that only benefits them in 2024.
sentences.zh: 那只会让他们在2024年受益。

sentences.en: So bottom line, what you're saying is actually getting to a point where House Republicans would vote to impeach President Biden is pretty unpopular among Republicans,
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，你的意思是，众议院共和党人投票弹劾拜登总统在共和党内部其实非常不受欢迎，

sentences.en: particularly the moderate ones trying to hold on to their seats and they think might actually benefit Democrats.
sentences.zh: 特别是对于那些试图保住席位的温和派议员，他们认为这实际上可能对民主党有利。

sentences.en: So it doesn't seem like there's a whole lot of enthusiasm for this being anything other than a gesture to appease the Matt Gaetz's of the world.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来并没有太大的热情，除了作为一种安抚像马特·盖茨那样的人的姿态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so time will tell on that.
sentences.zh: 时间会证明一切。

sentences.en: Is it just an investigation that spins its wheels forever and never leads to an actual impeachment vote?
sentences.zh: 这是否只是一场永远在原地打转、永远不会导致实际弹劾投票的调查？

sentences.en: It could be.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: But there's also a belief on the Hill that launching an impeachment inquiry is a bit like jumping out of a plane.
sentences.zh: 但国会山也有人认为，发起弹劾调查有点像跳伞。

sentences.en: Once you're in the air, you're going to hit the ground.
sentences.zh: 一旦你身处空中，你就注定要落地。

sentences.en: That at some point after you've investigated enough,
sentences.zh: 在调查足够充分后的某个时刻，

sentences.en: you will have to call for the vote and you will have to force this tough vote on the Republicans in the House to see up or down.
sentences.zh: 你将不得不要求投票，你将不得不强迫众议院的共和党人进行这次艰难的投票，以决定赞成还是反对。

sentences.en: Are they going to move to impeach President Biden?
sentences.zh: 他们会采取行动弹劾拜登总统吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in which case they may need to do something that they know inflicts a lot of political damage on themselves.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们可能需要做一些他们知道会对自己造成巨大政治损害的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a lot of Republicans will tell you when they look back at the first Trump impeachment,
sentences.zh: 很多共和党人会告诉你，当他们回顾第一次特朗普弹劾案时，

sentences.en: they believe that they did well when the Democrats moved against Trump on the first impeachment politically.
sentences.zh: 他们认为当民主党人在第一次弹劾中针对特朗普时，他们在政治上表现得很好。

sentences.en: And they don't want to see the same thing happen to them in this House.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望同样的事情发生在自己身上。

sentences.en: Well, to that point, Luke, I want to end by asking you to reflect on the reality that we are now enduring our third impeachment process in just a few years.
sentences.zh: 卢克，说到这一点，我想最后请你反思一下我们现在正在经历短短几年内的第三次弹劾程序的现实。

sentences.en: This one, weirdly enough, hearkening back to some of the same circumstances as the first impeachment of President Trump, Hunter Biden, Joe Biden, Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，这次弹劾让人回想起与特朗普总统第一次弹劾案相同的一些情况：亨特·拜登、乔·拜登、乌克兰。

sentences.en: And despite very real differences between these impeachments,
sentences.zh: 尽管这些弹劾之间存在非常真实的差异，

sentences.en: it does feel like we are living in a world where impeachment is now viewed much more than I think we ever imagined it would be as an everyday tool of political life.
sentences.zh: 但感觉我们生活在一个弹劾被视为政治生活中日常工具的世界里，这比我想象的要多得多。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that's very much the case.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为确实如此。

sentences.en: It used to be that impeachment was reserved only for the rarest of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 过去，弹劾仅保留给最罕见的情况。

sentences.en: And in this Congress, we've seen various Republicans have introduced articles of impeachment against five different members of the Biden administration,
sentences.zh: 而在本届国会中，我们看到不同的共和党人已经对拜登政府的五名不同成员提出了弹劾条款，

sentences.en: the Homeland Security Secretary, the Attorney General up and down the line.
sentences.zh: 从国土安全部长到司法部长，一应俱全。

sentences.en: And we've long ago, I think, left the idea that you had to prove a high crime to start an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 我想我们早就抛弃了必须证明犯有重罪才能启动弹劾调查的想法。

sentences.en: And we are now in the phase of the impeachment inquiry has enough political benefits on its own.
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于弹劾调查本身就具有足够政治利益的阶段。

sentences.en: So might as well go ahead and do it.
sentences.zh: 所以不妨直接去做吧。

sentences.en: Well, Luke, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，卢克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Thursday,
sentences.zh: 周四，

sentences.en: federal prosecutors charged Hunter Biden with lying about his drug use when he purchased a handgun in 2018 and for illegally possessing the weapon after a plea deal involving those charges collapsed.
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官指控亨特·拜登在2018年购买手枪时谎报吸毒情况，并在涉及这些指控的认罪协议破裂后非法持有该武器。

sentences.en: The charges do not implicate President Biden,
sentences.zh: 这些指控并未牵连拜登总统，

sentences.en: whose administration rolled out what the Times described as a long-planned strategy for defending itself against the House impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 他的政府推出了《纽约时报》所描述的长期计划，旨在防御众议院的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: As part of that strategy, White House officials and their allies dismissed the allegations against the president as baseless and debunked,
sentences.zh: 作为该策略的一部分，白宫官员及其盟友驳斥了针对总统的指控，称其毫无根据且已被揭穿，

sentences.en: attacked House Republicans for distorting the evidence, and pushed the news media to frame the entire conflict on the president's terms as a naked act of political partisanship.
sentences.zh: 抨击众议院共和党人歪曲证据，并推动新闻媒体将整个冲突定性为总统所说的赤裸裸的政治党派行为。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday evening, with their latest contract set to expire at midnight,
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，随着他们最新的合同即将在午夜到期，

sentences.en: members of the nation's largest union of auto workers were preparing to begin a strike today against the three Detroit automakers, Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis.
sentences.zh: 全国最大的汽车工人工会成员准备在今天对底特律的三大汽车制造商——福特、通用汽车和斯特兰蒂斯——发起罢工。

sentences.en: The union said that the strike would likely begin with limited walkouts at specific auto plants in an attempt to disrupt carmakers' production while still allowing most workers to keep collecting a paycheck.
sentences.zh: 工会表示，罢工可能会从特定汽车工厂的有限停工开始，试图扰乱汽车制造商的生产，同时仍允许大多数工人继续领取工资。

sentences.en: Negotiations between the union and the carmakers have made little progress.
sentences.zh: 工会与汽车制造商之间的谈判进展甚微。

sentences.en: The union has demanded 40% pay increases, arguing that the pay for the automakers' CEOs has risen by the same amount over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 工会要求加薪40%，理由是过去几年汽车制造商首席执行官的薪酬涨幅相同。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Prieto, Rob Zipko, and Ricky Nevetsky.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·普列托、罗布·齐普科和里基·内维茨基制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett, contains original music by Mary Lozano, Diane Wong, and Rowan Emisto, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·考维特编辑，包含玛丽·洛萨诺、黛安·王和罗文·埃米斯托的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《The Daily》的内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听我们的节目。
